name: Couch Cup
detailed_description:
Grab your friends, your phones, and your sense of humor—Couch Cup is here to turn your living room into the ultimate party arena! This chaotic, laugh-out-loud multiplayer game is perfect for groups of 3 to 12 players. Just connect your phones to the TV, customize your avatars, and dive into a series of unpredictable, hilarious, and competitive mini-games.

Key Features

🎮 A Variety of Mini-Games:
Test your trivia skills, outwit your friends in a strategic banana-stealing showdown, or unleash your creativity in drawing, debating, and storytelling games. With over a dozen of mini-games to explore, no two rounds of Couch Cup are ever the same!

🤖 AI-Powered Host:
Meet your new favorite game host—an AI with a quirky personality that reacts to your performance, delivers witty commentary, and keeps the party going.

📱 Play on Your Phone:
No controllers? No problem! Use your phone as the controller for drawing, typing, motion controls, and more. Connect easily via a room code and start playing in seconds.

💡 Endless Creativity:
Design dating profiles, solve ridiculous scenarios, or vote on the funniest fill-in-the-blank answers. Couch Cup is all about unleashing your imagination.

🍹 Optional Drinking Mode:
Want to spice up your game night? Activate Drinking Mode for hilarious challenges and prompts designed for adult audiences.

🛍️ Customizable Avatars:
Earn doubloons as you play and use them to unlock hats, outfits, and accessories. Express yourself and show off your unique style!

⚽ Multiplayer Madness:
Work together, compete against each other, or form teams in select mini-games. Whether it’s a soccer match or a team debate, teamwork and strategy are key!
